title: First hypnotic regression: tall being working on him
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Pleasant and these these were the the one that was messing with me was a very tall one

plain: A former guard at a nuclear site named Mario Woods says that under his first hypnotic regression, a session where hypnosis is used to bring back buried memories, he recalled being aboard a craft in South Dakota in 1977 while beings worked on him, and "the one that was messing with me was a very tall one." He tells Michels this about himself, as part of his account of being abducted. If true, it would put a nuclear site guard in the hands of non-human beings.
